mapper.select: select min(t2.market_price) as market_price, min(t2.supply_price) as supply_price, min(t2.sale_price) as sale_price, min(t2.unit_price) as unit_price, max(t2.market_price - t2.sale_price) as max_profit, min(t2.market_price) as market_price_began, max(t2.market_price) as market_price_end, min(t2.sale_price) as sale_price_began, max(t2.sale_price) as sale_price_end, min(t2.unit_price) as unit_price_began, max(t2.unit_price) as unit_price_end, min(t2.supply_price) as supplier_price_began, max(t2.supply_price) as supplier_price_end, min(t2.weight) as min_pricing_num, sum(t2.inventory) as inventory from sku t2 where t2.spu_id = #{spuId,jdbcType=BIGINT} group by t2.spu_id

SELECT t.id AS sku_id, t.`img` , t.`name` , t.`weight` , t.`volume` , t.`spu_id` , t.`supply_price` , t.`inventory` , t.`sale_attribute` as sale_attribute_json, t.`sale_price`, t.out_sku_id as outSkuId, t.buy_start_qty, t.`expand` as expand,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t1.market_id ORDER BY t1.market_id) as twoMarketIds, MAX(IF(t1.id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) as is_select,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t1.market_id ORDER BY t1.market_id) as twoMarketIds, MAX(t1.sell_price) as store_price,
t2.account_id as supplier_id, t2.freight_template_id, t2.state as spu_state, t2.img as spu_img, t2.name as spu_name, t2.out_spu_id as outSpuId, t2.channel_type as spu_channel_type FROM sku t
LEFT JOIN market_goods_relation t1 ON t.spu_id = t1.goods_id
LEFT JOIN store_distribution t1 ON t.id = t1.sku_id
LEFT JOIN spu t2 on t.spu_id = t2.id
and t1.user_id = #{channelId} and t1.relation_type = 3 and t1.state = 1
and t1.channel_id = #{channelId} and t1.store_id = #{storeId}
and t.id in
#{item.skuId}
GROUP BY t.id, t.spu_id

SELECT t.id AS sku_id, t.`img` , t.`name` , t.`weight` , t.`volume` , t.`spu_id` , t.`supply_price` , t.`inventory` , t.`sale_attribute` as sale_attribute_json, t.`sale_price`, t.out_sku_id as outSkuId, t2.account_id as supplier_id, t2.freight_template_id, t2.state as spu_state, t2.img as spu_img, t2.name as spu_name, t2.out_spu_id as outSpuId, t2.channel_type as spu_channel_type, t.buy_start_qty, t.expand FROM sku t LEFT JOIN spu t2 on t.spu_id = t2.id where t.id in
#{item}
